maya (People Ops): Heads up — noticed the scheduler is booking interviews with people who are still in 'Needs training' status in the LMS. Example: Candidate ABC-2026 got a panel with interviewer INT-556 at 2:30PM today even though their profile shows 'needs_training'. Seen this with 3 candidates so far.
samuel (Recruiting): same here, happened for the campus-hire feed. Candidate IDs I saw: ABC-2026, ABC-2029, ABC-2042. All from the same CSV import this morning.
devin (Eng - Integrations): can you paste the scheduler booking IDs or webhook delivery IDs? @ats-sync-bot any recent deliveries for those candidate IDs?
ats-sync-bot: Delivery log: id=dlv-87231 status=200 url=https://scheduler.internal/hook time=2026-03-19T14:01:12Z
ats-sync-bot: payload (trimmed):
```
{
  "candidate_id": "ABC-2026",
  "interviewers": ["INT-556"],
  "scheduled_at": "2026-03-19T14:30:00Z",
  "source": "campus-import-v2"
  // NOTE: no training_status / certified field present
}
```
rachel (Interview Training): we rolled out the new interviewer flag last week — field name changed in the LMS export from `training_complete` -> `interviewer_cert_v2` as part of the certification revamp. Sounds like the scheduler mapping expects `training_status` boolean, so the field rename could be why the scheduler treats them as certified by default.
maya (People Ops): ah okay that would explain it. The CSV import we used for campus hires used the new export from LMS; we didn't realize the field name changed. Is the scheduler treating missing field as "true" for certification?
devin (Eng - Integrations): yes, current mapping: `if payload.training_status == false then block else allow` — if the key is missing we fall through to allow. That's a bad default. I'll change fallback to block when field missing, but need to confirm exact field name we should use.
rachel (Interview Training): canonical values we shipped: `interviewer_cert_v2` = "certified" | "needs_training". We can emit a boolean `training_status` too if that helps. We intended to deprecate `training_complete` but didn't coordinate the mapping in the scheduler.
maya (People Ops): short-term manual workaround: I can flip the scheduler rule to block interviewers with label containing "needs_training". How do we do that? token-scheduler-bot can toggle route?
token-scheduler-bot: command accepted: `/block-label needs_training` — scheduler will treat users with that label as ineligible for auto-booking. Active now.
samuel (Recruiting): thanks, that should stop new bad bookings. But existing bookings need manual review — I'll go through today's calendar and reassign.
devin (Eng - Integrations): action plan:
1) hotfix mapper to check for both `training_status` (boolean) and `interviewer_cert_v2` (string) and treat missing as not-certified. Will push hotfix by 17:00 PST today (dlv-87302).
2) run a backfill job to fetch current LMS exports for last 48h and update scheduler profiles (will run overnight, ETA 06:00 UTC).
3) add 400-level alert if webhook payload missing expected training fields.
I can also add a one-off script to cancel/flag any future interviews scheduled with `needs_training` interviewers so recruiting ops can triage.
maya (People Ops): perfect. I'll coordinate manual triage; samuel and I will handle reschedules. Please ping here when hotfix is deployed.
devin (Eng - Integrations): noted — will post deploy msg here when live. tagging @rachel to confirm field semantics after deploy.
rachel (Interview Training): will update LMS export to include `training_status` boolean by EOD and add a short note in the export docs. Also will send a quick-mail to People Ops so future CSVs don't break.
maya (People Ops): thanks all — workaround active, hotfix expected today, backfill overnight, manual reschedule in progress. :white_check_mark:
samuel (Recruiting): adding this to the hiring-ops runbook under "imported-csv checks" so we check field mappings before bulk imports. :memo:
devin (Eng - Integrations): deploy note: hotfix pushed at 16:48 PST, migrator job scheduled (job id migr-998), will post status when backfill completes.
ats-sync-bot: migr-998 job started at 2026-03-20T02:05:00Z
maya (People Ops): thanks — closing monitoring loop; will reopen thread if we see more failures. :thumbsup:
